name: Ilustres Ignorantes
description: Programa de entretenimiento en el que los presentadores del programa y lxs invitadxs hablan sobre un tema determinado de modo desenfadado y cómico.

videos.title: Olympics
videos.overview: Pepín Tre is opening the season of "Ilustres Ignorantes" again, accompanied by actress Victoria Luengo. From the Alcázar Theatre in Madrid, this first programme is dedicated to the "Olympics". What new event would you like to see included in the next Olympics? What would you do for the next opening ceremony?

videos.title: Banks
videos.overview: Actress Cristina Castaño and comedian Raúl Cimas sit at the table of "Ilustres Ignorantes" to talk about "Banks." What do you like most about banks: the loans, the frying pans, the robbers...? How would you rob a bank?

videos.title: Layoffs
videos.overview: Journalist Raquel Sánchez Silva, along with Raúl Pérez, dressed as singer Omar Montes, talk about "Dismissals" in "Ilustres Ignorantes" (Illustrious Ignorants). Have you ever been fired? What do you think is the best way to fire someone?

videos.title: Language courses
videos.overview: Presenter Inés Hernand and comedian Andrés Fanjgold sit at the Ilustres table to talk about "Language Courses" What is the best language course you have ever taken? What is the ideal way to learn a language?

videos.title: Soap operas
videos.overview: Actress Cristina Gallego and chef Pepe Rodríguez visit "Ilustres Ignorantes" to talk about "Telenovelas" What fascinates you the most: the leading man, the evil twin,...? What telenovela would you like to do and what role would you play?

videos.title: The breakup
videos.overview: Actress Leonor Watling and Raúl Pérez dressed as Robe Iniesta talk on Ilustres about "The breakup." What has been your most painful breakup: with your high school sweetheart, your phone company? Have you ever had your heart broken?

videos.title: Sleep
videos.overview: Actress Juana Cordero and comedian Juan Dávila talk about "Dormir" in Ilustres Ignorantes. What are your routines: reading, seven pillows...? What keeps you awake? Have you ever pretended to be asleep? What do you do when you wake up?

videos.title: The buses
videos.overview: Journalist Valeria Vegas and comedian Alex Clavero sit at the Ilustres table to talk about "Los autocares" What do you like most about travelling by bus: the film, the driver, the 15-minute stops...?

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: Actress and singer Angy Fernández and comedian David Fernández talk on Ilustres de "Halloween" What would the perfect "Halloween" night be like for them? What do they think is the best costume for that night? Do they go trick or treating? Do they decorate their houses?

videos.title: Ballads
videos.overview: Comedian Eva Soriano and journalist José Luis Sastre visit the set of Ilustres to talk about “Baladas” What should a good ballad have: good music, good lyrics, a seductive singer…? Do they slow dance in a disco?

videos.title: Honeymoon
videos.overview: Actress Marta González de Vega and Raúl Pérez, dressed as Marc Giró, sit at the table of Illustrious People to talk about their "honeymoon." What would your ideal honeymoon be like? Where on the planet would you travel to? How long should your honeymoon last?
